**Re-deploying for App**

For when needing new authentication code due to either login issues or after factory reset.

- Go to the 'Micollab client' (can get there through Mitel admin)
    - Search for the name - expand
    - ![](data:image/png;base64,)
- Head to 'MiCollab Client Deployment' on the left of the new page opened
- Search for the name of the user.
- Tick the box of the user - Select the dropdown in the bottom right where it says 'Sync data'
- Click Deploy - click action
